CFML Language Reference: Functions

ListFirst

Returns the first element of a list. If the list is empty, the result is an empty string.

Category

List functions

Syntax

ListFirst(list [, delimiters ])

Parameters

list
The list.
delimiters
Optional. The delimiter characters of the list; the default is a comma.

Returns

The first element.

Usage

Leading delimiters are skipped, so the first element of ",,apple,pear" is "apple". ListRest returns everything after the first element, and the two together let you walk through a list one element at a time. ListLast returns the last element.

Example

Opens the example in a new window. The example runs on this server, so it only works when you browse from the server itself (127.0.0.1).
<CFSET Path = "/CFDOCS/snippets/listfirst.cfm">
<CFSET Email = "webmaster@localhost">
<CFOUTPUT>
<TABLE BORDER=1 CELLPADDING=3>
<TR><TH>Expression</TH><TH>Result</TH></TR>
<TR><TD>ListFirst("Larry,Moe,Curly")</TD><TD>#ListFirst("Larry,Moe,Curly")#</TD></TR>
<TR><TD>ListFirst(Path, "/")</TD><TD>#ListFirst(Path, "/")#</TD></TR>
<TR><TD>ListFirst(Email, "@")</TD><TD>#ListFirst(Email, "@")#</TD></TR>
<TR><TD>ListFirst("")</TD><TD>[#ListFirst("")#]</TD></TR>
</TABLE>
</CFOUTPUT>
